_about: Immuta-style policies for the employees data source. Authored once, applied per user from the attributes in the caller's tagged session (dept, role, clr). This mirrors Immuta's model (subscription policy + data policies: row filter and column masking); it is not Immuta's own policy syntax.

subscription_policy.description: Analysts and managers may use this data source. Contractors may not.

data_policies.description: Only show rows for the user's own department.
Redact pay and bank columns unless the user holds restricted clearance.
